done_when: tests/test_fix_close_pushes_its_review_commit_while_the.py test_3 proves the waits by checking each gap is at least the planned wait for that attempt (1, 2 and 4 seconds) and that close gives up after the bounded attempts, instead of comparing measured gaps with each other; it still fails if the waits are removed.
why: The push-retry test fails on loaded CI runners: it asserts that the measured gaps between push attempts grow, but each gap includes the git command's own time, which under load swamps the 1, 2 and 4 second waits (seen as 11.0, 10.8 and 5.1 seconds)
